videos.title: LIVE: LA County ballot processing center holds a briefing
videos.description:
Los Angeles County ballot processing center holds a briefing on the day of the midterm elections as Americans head to the polls.
 
The elections will deliver a verdict on President Trump's second term, with surveys and nonpartisan analysts favoring Democrats to win control of the House of Representatives, while control of the Senate remains uncertain.

videos.title: LIVE: Republican Senate candidate Dan Sullivan casts his vote in Alaska
videos.description:
Republican Senate candidate Dan Sullivan casts his vote in Anchorage, Alaska.
 
The Alaska Senate race has been thrown into turmoil after a media report that the campaign of Democratic candidate Mary Peltola, 53, helped recruit a third candidate who shares the first and last name of her Republican opponent, Dan Sullivan, 61.
 
Peltola has denied involvement. Trump's Justice Department has launched a criminal probe into the allegations and filed a lawsuit to block certification of the election results, though a judge dismissed the latter effort.
